title: Codex Update Manifest
description: Artifact/provenance contract for a single release. Tied to a channel (alpha|beta|stable) and a tranche. Carries release-notes binding, AppImage artifact identity, workflow provenance, eligibility policy, promotion lineage, and a reserved signature field.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this manifest contract. Bump on any field-list or cross-field-rule change (F1 closure schema-version discipline). Bumped 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 in SD16-F-WINDOWS to admit two new optional platform-identity blocks paralleling linux_appimage: windows_msi and macos_dmg. The AppImage block remains required so prior publishers stay conformant. The schema remains closed-world: unknown top-level fields are still rejected. Both '1.0.0' and '1.1.0' are accepted here so that v1.0.0 manifests already deployed on the update-index branch continue to validate against the new closed-world rules — the 1.1.0 release only ADDS optional blocks, so the additive change is backwards-compatible and we explicitly do NOT reject pre-1.1.0 manifests. Future additive bumps that are non-breaking continue this pattern; non-additive breaks require a separate breaking-bump workflow.

tag.description: Release tag, prefixed by the channel. Must satisfy cross-field rule tag.split('/')[0] == channel.

tranche_id.description: Identifier of the tranche that produced this release. Locked to STC-CODEX-SD-16 for the duration of this contract (AV-SCH-5, schema-side half).

source_branch.description: Git branch this release was built from. Branch name characters only.

source_commit.description: Full SHA-1 hex commit hash this release was built from.

release_notes_path.description: Repo-relative path to the tranche release-notes.md. Locked to the canonical docs/release/<SD-NN>/release-notes.md path (AV-SCH-6). Relocated 2026-07-20 from programs/codex/requirements/<stc-id>/release-notes.md as part of a repo-wide docs-structure consolidation; manifests published before that date reference the old path and are not retroactively updated.

release_notes_url.description: Canonical URL where the release notes can be fetched.

release_notes_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the release-notes file referenced by release_notes_path.

linux_appimage.description: Linux AppImage artifact identity (name, URL, hash, size). First-class self-update target per technical-requirements §AppImage Install Requirements.

name.description: File name of the AppImage artifact.

url.description: Canonical URL where the AppImage artifact can be fetched.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the AppImage artifact.

size_bytes.description: Size of the AppImage artifact in bytes.

windows_msi.description: Windows MSI artifact identity (name, URL, hash, size). Optional parallel of linux_appimage for the tester Windows lane added in SD16-F-WINDOWS. Schema 1.0.0 publishers do not set this; schema 1.1.0 publishers set this when the publish-tester-release-windows job produces a .msi. The schema admits it as OPTIONAL so back-compat with v1.0.0 manifests remains intact.

name.description: File name of the Windows MSI artifact.

url.description: Canonical URL where the Windows MSI artifact can be fetched.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the Windows MSI artifact.

size_bytes.description: Size of the Windows MSI artifact in bytes.

macos_dmg.description: macOS DMG artifact identity (name, URL, hash, size). Optional parallel of linux_appimage / windows_msi for the tester macOS lane added in SD16-F-WINDOWS. Same contract: optional, closed-world, identical required-key shape so the discovery path can be generalized. Production macOS DMGs typically require Developer ID signing + notarization; that work is deferred and an unsigned DMG is shipped for tester delivery until the Apple-cert epic lands.

name.description: File name of the macOS DMG artifact.

url.description: Canonical URL where the macOS DMG artifact can be fetched.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the macOS DMG artifact.

size_bytes.description: Size of the macOS DMG artifact in bytes.

workflow_provenance.description: Provenance of the workflow that produced this release: workflow file, run id, and run attempt.

workflow.description: Path of the GitHub Actions workflow file that produced this release.

run_attempt.description: GitHub Actions run attempt number (starts at 1).

eligibility.description: Eligibility policy for the shell's Install enabler. Decides whether a given installed state may self-update to this release.

min_supported_version.description: Minimum installed version eligible to update to this release.

appimage_install.description: If true, this release supports AppImage-based self-update.

required_install_kind.description: Install kind required for self-update eligibility.

promotion_lineage.description: Promotion ancestry of this release: which source branch was promoted into the target channel.

source_branch.description: Branch this release was promoted FROM.

source_commit.description: SHA-1 hex commit this release was promoted FROM.

promoted_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the promotion occurred.

signature.description: Reserved signature field. Cryptographic signing is deferred for Tranche 2.5 (AV-SCH-3); null is accepted, a populated object is reserved for a future contract bump.

allOf.description: Cross-field rule: tag prefix must equal channel (F1 closure §Update manifest contract).
